## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: weak overall breadth and defensive outperformance (Healthcare & Consumer Stpl. positive with JNJ ABOVE TREND) alongside concentrated Technology weakness (Technology 1W -2.81% with multiple large caps BELOW TREND). Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: OXY (1W: +13.81% | 1M: +21.51%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +13.56%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.62% | 1M: +12.04%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: GE (1W: +7.48% | 1M: +14.91%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +23.83%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare showing resilience: SYK (1W: +5.10% | 1M: +7.27%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +12.52%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: MSFT (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -14.58%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -17.70%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -11.76% | 1M: -20.69%) BELOW TREND. Financials weak: JPM (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -1.96%) BELOW TREND, COF (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -18.86%) BELOW TREND despite PYPL (1W: +9.33% | 1M: -22.92%) RECOVERY. Consumer Discretionary soft: TSLA (1W: -4.22% | 1M: -11.02%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: +3.26% | 1M: -12.41%) RECOVERY.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: OXY (1W: +13.81% | 1M: +21.51%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +9.33% | 1M: -22.92%) RECOVERY, GE (1W: +7.48% | 1M: +14.91%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +23.83%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +5.64% | 1M: +6.66%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (Energy, Financials, Industrials, Technology represented), implying rotation rather than single-sector melt-up.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: ADBE (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -17.70%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -6.74% | 1M: +6.95%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -6.75% | 1M: -19.68%) BELOW TREND, ETN (1W: -6.99% | 1M: +8.39%) CORRECTION, COF (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -18.86%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Technology/selected Financials and lingering trend exhaustion in parts of Materials/Industrials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Leading 1W momentum: OXY (1W: +13.81% | 1M: +21.51%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +9.33% | 1M: -22.92%) RECOVERY, GE (1W: +7.48% | 1M: +14.91%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +23.83%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence flagged — several large caps (PYPL, AMZN, GOOGL, EL, LLY) show 1W/1M mismatch, indicating tactical moves not yet broad-based; watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed to weak: NVDA (1W: +4.78% | 1M: +3.63%) ABOVE TREND and AAPL (1W: +4.07% | 1M: +7.28%) ABOVE TREND, but MSFT (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -14.58%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -17.70%) BELOW TREND and ORCL (1W: -11.76% | 1M: -20.69%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -2.81% with broad large-cap weakness; technology breadth remains a drag.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Caution: PYPL (1W: +9.33% | 1M: -22.92%) RECOVERY and select cyclicals show strength, but core names are soft — JPM (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -1.96%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -2.41% | 1M: -5.89%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -6.91%) BELOW TREND. Financials 1W: -1.56% with mixed leadership; style: mixed, tilt defensive/cyclical rather than Growth.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive footing: JNJ (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +12.52%) ABOVE TREND, SYK (1W: +5.10% | 1M: +7.27%) ABOVE TREND and ABBV headline support. UNH (1W: -3.70% | 1M: -20.35%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: +1.78% | 1M: -2.49%) RECOVERY create intra-sector dispersion. Healthcare 1W: +0.41% — defensive demand present.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor defensive and selected cyclical names showing confirmed strength (OXY, XOM, GE, DE) and reduce exposure to large-cap Technology names that are predominantly BELOW TREND. Style: mixed with a defensive tilt; monitor PYPL/AMAT for takeover-driven reversals but treat those as tactical opportunities.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: OXY (1W: +13.81% | 1M: +21.51%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming; PYPL (1W: +9.33% | 1M: -22.92%) RECOVERY — takeover chatter, watch follow-through; AMAT (1W: +5.38% | 1M: +17.32%) ABOVE TREND — positive fundamentals. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -17.70%) BELOW TREND — negative sentiment confirming, TSLA (1W: -4.22% | 1M: -11.02%) BELOW TREND, IBM (1W: -14.88% | 1M: -23.77%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (OXY, XOM, CVX ABOVE TREND) — momentum and positive newsflow. BEARISH: Technology (multiple large caps BELOW TREND and sector 1W -2.81%); Financials to watch for volatility around takeover rumors (PYPL RECOVERY amid broad Financials weakness).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA continuation above last weekly high for confirmation of its ABOVE TREND path and AAPL holding recent 1M support to validate its ABOVE TREND. Monitor OXY for sustainment of the 1W breakout and PYPL for confirmation of takeover-driven momentum versus its 1M downtrend. Use weekly closes as the trigger for rotation decisions.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
PYPL (+75): PayPal takeover chatter; PYPL (1W: +9.33% | 1M: -22.92%) RECOVERY — sentiment partly confirms 1W move but 1M weakness remains. AMAT (+60): Applied Materials upbeat; AMAT (1W: +5.38% | 1M: +17.32%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming. OXY (+70): bullish coverage/interest; OXY (1W: +13.81% | 1M: +21.51%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed and accumulation evident. GE (+55): commercial aerospace orders; GE (1W: +7.48% | 1M: +14.91%) ABOVE TREND — confirming.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
TSLA (-80): adverse Autopilot ruling; TSLA (1W: -4.22% | 1M: -11.02%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming downside risk. IBM (-65): negative headline; IBM (1W: -14.88% | 1M: -23.77%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming heavy distribution. ADBE (-50): downgrade/AI concerns; ADBE (1W: -6.55% | 1M: -17.70%) BELOW TREND — confirming. XOM (-50): legal/board risks; XOM (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +13.56%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment diverging from price, watch for knee-jerk selloffs.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with a defensive tilt over Growth given 4/11 sector breadth and concentrated tech weakness. OXY (1W: +13.81% | 1M: +21.51%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +7.48% | 1M: +14.91%) ABOVE TREND and DE (1W: +7.28% | 1M: +23.83%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence across large caps and sentiment-driven moves (PYPL, AMZN, GOOGL) that may be tactical rather than broad-based.
